features.name: Bulk order export to CSV/Excel
features.description: Ops users can export up to 100k orders with filters (date range, status, region) to CSV or Excel, generated asynchronously with an email link when ready.

criteria: User selects date range, status, and region filters before export
Export runs asynchronously for datasets over 5k rows; user gets an email with a download link
CSV and Excel (.xlsx) formats are both supported
Export respects row-level permissions — user only sees orders in their assigned regions
